description:
## Summary

- **Remove `zeroconf>=0.148.0`** from runtime deps — no imports anywhere in the repo; ADR-008 planned but never implemented
- **Remove `oauthlib>=3.3.1`** from runtime deps — redundant transitive dependency of `requests-oauthlib` (which is the only package actually imported)
- **Move `aiohttp>=3.13.3`** from runtime to dev — only used in `tests/` (2 files) and `scripts/` (1 file), not imported in `mcpgateway/`
- **Remove redundant `alembic` optional extra** — `alembic` is already a required runtime dependency
- **Remove `zeroconf` from `tox.ini`** — matching the pyproject.toml removal
- **Bump various dependency version pins** across runtime, dev, and optional extras

## Test plan

- [x] `uv sync` confirms `zeroconf` and `ifaddr` removed from environment
- [x] Application imports successfully (`from mcpgateway.main import app`)
- [x] Full test suite passes (`pytest tests/ -x`)

Closes #2651

commits.message:
chore: remove unused runtime dependencies from pyproject.toml

Remove unused and redundant runtime dependencies to reduce installation
footprint and dependency maintenance burden.

- Remove `zeroconf` (never implemented, ADR-008 planned only)
- Remove `oauthlib` (redundant transitive dep of `requests-oauthlib`)
- Move `aiohttp` from runtime to dev-only (only used in tests/scripts)
- Remove redundant `alembic` optional extra (already a required dep)
- Remove `zeroconf` from tox.ini
- Bump `aiohttp` dev version to >=3.13.3
- Bump various dependency version pins

Closes #2651

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
